programme.title: Deep Time History
programme.desc: About 8,000 BC, in a few select places some people begin to experiment with a new way of harvesting energy. They're growing their own crops. An act so simple, it's hard to believe it will kick start a revolution. But it will. These are the first seeds, literally, of the rise of civilization.

programme.title: Deep Time History
programme.desc: Columbus has no idea that because of Earth's geology and geography he won't get to his destination…or how that epic failure will make his voyage one of the most influential expeditions in the history of humankind. Let's add an asteroid hitting the earth billions of years ago and connect the dots...

programme.title: Deep Time History
programme.desc: The Industrial Revolution and the rise of modern warfare have roots in the depths of time-in the natural process that enriches the soil. How do prehistoric forests link to the development of steam engines, and the rise of modern industry?

programme.title: Celts: The Untold Story
programme.desc: A journey to some of the mysteries of how the early Celts emerged and expanded since the 8th Century BC: from the collapse of the Hallstatt salt mines, to the bizarre rituals inside Bull Rock cave, the location of the lost city of Pyrene or the strange constructions found in Glauberg or Alteburg.

programme.title: Celts: The Untold Story
programme.desc: After thriving as traders for over 3 centuries, the Celts reinvented themselves as fearless warriors who waged war all over Europe. Their weapons were among the most advanced of its time and their distinguished metal art would also develop in this period that many define as the Celtic golden age.

programme.title: Celts: The Untold Story
programme.desc: In the 2nd Century BC, Celtic tribes established prosperous cities dedicated to trade along the Amber Road and the Danube. But external threats to their society forced them into smaller fortified settlements known as oppida. This marked the beginning of the decline of the Celts in Central Europe.

programme.desc: Survivors of Michael Myer's first rampage decide to take matters into their own hands, forming a vigilante mob that sets out to hunt Michael down, once and for all.

programme.title: White House Down

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code

This episode takes you to the heart of crisis-stricken areas, where Gareth's willingness to get involved sees him join together with others to help rebuild not just homes, but hope. Witness the incredible power of community spirit in the face of adversity.

programme.title: I Heard the Bells
programme.desc: The inspiring story behind the writing of the beloved Christmas carol and its author, Henry Wadsworth Longfellow. Known as America's Poet, Henry Wadsworth Longfellow leads an idyllic life...until the day his world is shattered by tragedy. With a nation divided by Civil War and his family torn apart, Henry puts down his pen, silenced by grief. But it's the sound of Christmas morning that reignites the poet's lost voice as he discovers the resounding hope of rekindled faith.

programme.title: Hour Of Power
programme.desc: Since 1970 the Hour of Power has been reaching viewers from around the world. Originally founded by Dr Robert H Schuller, the program became the most-watched religious program in the world, reaching 17 million viewers. Now under the leadership of Bobby Schuller, Dr Schuller’s grandson. The congregation worships at Shepherd’s Grove Church in Garden Grove, CA. The program aims to provide spiritual principles and practices that can help people, as they become happy students of Jesus and live a life of meaning. To learn more about who they are in Christ through the process of formation, to belong to his family of believers and become a part of the community and to heal as they are loved and then love and help heal others through mission. Jesus Christ ushered in the Kingdom of God into our world through His death and resurrection. He invites everyone to be a part of this amazing movement by trusting and following Him. There is no fuller, richer life than the one that is lived in Christ.

programme.title: LIFETV with Paul de Jong - Shaken Pt.3
programme.desc: Shaken Pt.3. We like to call it 'soul food'. LIFE TV uses creative illustration, real life stories and biblical teaching to encourage and help viewers discover a greater purpose to their lives.

programme.title: Answers with Bayless Conley - Jonah: When a Nation Believed God
programme.desc: Jonah: When a Nation Believed God. What does real faith look like when there’s no physical evidence to support it? In message six from his series on the book of Jonah, When a Nation Believed God, Pastor Bayless examines the response of the people of Nineveh as they believed God’s warning and acted on His Word. You’ll learn why repentance still matters, why God always warns before judgment, and how His justice and mercy meet perfectly through Jesus Christ. Dive in and discover what it means to truly believe God and act on His promises.

programme.title: Enjoying Everyday Life with Joyce Meyer - Are You Working from Approval or for Approval? - Part 1
programme.desc: Are You Working from Approval or for Approval? - Part 1. Do you feel like you need to earn God’s approval? Today, Joyce shares wisdom from God’s Word to remind you of how much He already loves and approves of you.

programme.title: Katherine Ruonala
programme.desc: Katherine Ruonala shares a practical message of love and hope to the nations. Reaching across denominational walls, her ministry is used to spread the fires of revival and ignite a fresh passion in the hearts of believers to go deeper in their relationship with God. Katherine carries a strong prophetic and miracle anointing with many experiencing instant healing in her meetings.

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc:
Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home.

The Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons.

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: Golden Fries, a food truck venture founded by Jesse Teasdale and his wife, has become a popular spot at Bluesfest Ottawa. The truck, which started as a one-woman operation, quickly gained traction and now sees massive crowds, even requiring early gate openings for events like the Foo Fighters' performance. The menu highlights a classic poutine, made with fresh-cut fries, squeaky cheese curds, and rich gravy, as its top-selling item. The video captures various attendees raving about the quality and taste of the food, emphasizing the truck's commitment to using local, high-quality ingredients. Additionally, the video showcases the preparation and dedication that goes into running the truck, from early morning setups to handling large orders for bands and their crews. The narrative underscores the community spirit and the joy of sharing delicious food at live events.
